notes: Both reliable endpoints run on one board with crossed UARTs; this is not a two-board measurement.
passed is the saved runner correctness/lifecycle result, not a performance-threshold verdict.
Only passed runs with complete numeric RESULT rates receive accepted throughput summaries.
ESP32 reliable-mode UART error rows marked observed=0 are not independent hardware-error observations; payload and lifecycle checks remain the correctness evidence.
Each summary is the minimum, arithmetic mean and maximum useful-payload rate across that run.
Short independent screens do not establish combined or sustained configuration minima.
Task priorities are local scheduler values; producer/sender/receiver relationships also affect throughput.
Some initial screens adjust sender priorities through the private harness; use explicit sender_prio configuration rows to identify public-API measurements.
A sender_priority argument of zero retains the library default; application priority zero preserves the original application scheduling.
Build repository HEADs identify provenance at build time; source snapshot digests describe the actual copied source files, including pending edits.
Compact source digests hash the sorted JSON relative-path-to-SHA256 map as UTF-8 with comma/colon separators and no whitespace.
Transcripts are console-only evidence, with absolute local paths and MAC addresses redacted if present.
